record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Characterize all directed complete posets P for which there exists a T0 well-filtered topology tau on the underlying set of P that is compatible with the original order, meaning cl_tau({x})=down x for every x in P. In this setting, well-filtered means that for every open set U and every directed family of nonempty compact saturated subsets, if the intersection of that family is contained in U, then some member of the family is already contained in U.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(P,\le)$ be a directed complete poset (dcpo); that is, every directed subset of $P$ has a supremum in $P$. For $x\in P$, write ${\downarrow}x=\{y\in P: y\le x\}$. A topology $\tau$ on the underlying set of $P$ is said to be compatible with the order $\le$ if, for every $x\in P$, the $\tau$-closure of $\{x\}$ equals ${\downarrow}x$ (in particular, $\tau$ is $T_0$ and its specialization order coincides with $\le$).

A topological space $(X,\tau)$ is called well-filtered if, for every open set $U\in\tau$ and every filtered family $\mathcal{K}$ of nonempty compact saturated subsets of $X$ (where saturated means equal to the intersection of its open neighborhoods, and filtered means that for any $K_1,K_2\in\mathcal{K}$ there exists $K_3\in\mathcal{K}$ with $K_3\subseteq K_1\cap K_2$), the condition $\bigcap\mathcal{K}\subseteq U$ implies $K\subseteq U$ for some $K\in\mathcal{K}$.

Problem. Give an intrinsic order-theoretic characterization of those dcpos $P$ for which there exists a $T_0$ topology $\tau$ on $P$ that is compatible with $\le$ and makes $(P,\tau)$ a well-filtered space.
artifact.status_search_result: The characterization of well-filtered dcpos is listed as an open question in surveys on well-filtered and sober spaces. While related questions have been resolved (e.g., Kou's counterexample to Heckmann's UK-admitting=sober question, and Jia's and Zhao–Xi–Chen's examples of well-filtered non-sober dcpos), no intrinsic order-theoretic characterization of well-filtered dcpos appears in the literature; related questions such as whether every core-compact dcpo is sober remain open.

status_evidence.title: A discussion of well-filteredness and sobriety
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys recent progress and lists open problems concerning well-filtered and sober dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Characterization of well-filtered dcpos remains an active open problem in domain theory.

status_evidence.title: On open well-filtered spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Every core-compact open well-filtered space is sober; whether every core-compact dcpo is sober remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Related characterization questions for well-filtered dcpos are unresolved.

status_evidence.title: X. Jia's well-filtered, non-sober dcpo
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs a well-filtered dcpo that is not sober, showing the class is strictly larger than sober dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Well-filtered dcpos form a nontrivial class lacking a known intrinsic characterization.
